verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth is an authentication service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI probes are adjacent agent-readable resources, not an MCP server an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
